scope: Folder-linked GLB authoring and automatic source refresh; no FPS claim
coverage: Current disk art resolves through v2 relative model references without embedded copies of linked models
Portable v1 snapshots strip source links and folder identity; recovery v1 retains both and full cached bytes
Real GLTFLoader accessor failure preserves exact rendered pixels, document, history and IndexedDB recovery
Completed source export retries automatically and updates painted foliage and props without changing authoring references
Undo restores prior art; two unchanged metadata polls do not redo it; redo restores the new art
Root-file saving, external write conflict rejection and byte-identical pre-conversion backup
Cancelled folder choice and injected new-root write failure preserve the open document and allow same-folder retry
Recovered unsaved edits survive folder reauthorization after browser reload
Linked foliage review retains scale and pivot recipe; existing sources can be retargeted or detached
Source aliases resolve once, path traversal and external GLB dependencies reject, failed reads retry
Undo then linked Save rejects mismatched art without changing the root file, scene, history or recovery; embedding the older version saves and reopens it without rewriting its source
A broken GPU revision does not block valid sibling source refreshes, including forced refresh with automatic refresh off
An export completing between metadata observations cannot split same-source aliases across art revisions
A root document changed during GPU preparation rejects opening without changing the live document, history or recovery
A source changed during staged saving aborts publication; refreshing, saving and reopening then succeeds
Save compares model bytes across valid legacy MIME and unpadded base64 spellings
